method: Independent comparison of build controls with source-derived opening schedules and direct inspection of all nine newly rendered PNGs. Final hashes computed after lossless normalization. Visual/source review only, not print or structural certification.
source_basis: 2004 official survey report PDF260–267 plans, exterior elevations and sections; source originals not included.

previews.observation: Main ring, open court and distinct western hall; no duplicate northern host door beside projected entrance.
Later southern open gallery and eastern level-specific annexes remain distinct; roof on posts rather than solid thirdstorey.
Independent asymmetric west opening groups; corrected paired-door divisions visible.
24-field layered east schedule, broad upper high-strip pattern and neutral unknown fields; paired entrance visible.
Independent north40-field control; northeastern upper-door connection and single western projected ground-door group.
Independent south40-field control with separate short/high-window ranges; attached gallery stays open.
Ring courtyard and two smaller western courts retain plan massing; semicircular low baths not fountains.
Broad gable and narrow raised monitor distinguished; simplified main facade groups and paired-door divisions visible.
Main court long/short plan-supported neutral openings, four stair masses, chamfer lower paired doors and two upper neutral panes; central fountain deliberately omitted.

resolved_findings: Paired-door central divisions now survive doorway subtraction, including diagonal courtyard doors.
Duplicated north ground host doorway suppressed; projecting-wing end door represents that source group.
qualifications: 263/264 repeat a nominal north elevation; its south assignment and265north assignment are plan/projection-based inferences, not corrected official captions.
40long-face fields and short-face groups are simplified visual groups, not exact historic operable sash-leaf inventory.
Courtyard opening counts/locations are plan-supported but heights and plain panes are authored display proxies.
Southern terminal west joinery subgroups remain approximate rather than mirrored from north.
Raster-scaled dimensions, roof support sections/pitches, annex heights, guards, materials/colors and fine detail are approximate.
Roof-level metal-sheet additions remain open raised shelters, not a complete third-storey reconstruction.
Two low semicircular bath masses use approximate height; their unverified detailed openings/interiors are not restored. Central courtyard fountain is excluded.
Doorways use blind backing; interior circulation, stairs, services and complete construction details are not reconstructed.
No physical trial print, present-condition validation or structural-safety conclusion.
